summary.text: Adam Schnelting is a Republican member of the Missouri Senate for District 23, which includes part of St. Charles County, first elected in 2024.
His official Senate page lists him as chair of the Transportation, Infrastructure and Public Safety Committee and vice-chair of Veterans and Military Affairs.

paragraphs.text: The Senate biography describes Schnelting as an Army Combat Engineer who now serves in the Individual Ready Reserve, and as a seventh-generation Missourian.

It says he served three terms in the Missouri House of Representatives before his election to the Senate, and lists a degree in Christian ministry from Oklahoma Wesleyan University and a baccalaureate degree from the University of Missouri-St. Louis.
He lives in St. Charles with his wife, Christine, and their two children, according to the page.
